test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
**Directions: **These questions are based on the following information.

there are six members in the family; S, B, H, W, X and O, but not necessarily in the same order. B is the mother-in-law of H who is the mother of O. O is granddaughter of S who have only one daughter. W is the son-in-law of S. X is the uncle of O. How X is related to H?
solution:
From the given information,

Six family members: B, S, H, W, X and O,

Explanation with family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50898b3263e1ba00309250c76c9e8af496485b4e0ed2becdd5bb613d5c9c030e.png] 

1) B is the mother-in-law of H who is the mother of O. O is granddaughter of S who have only one daughter. X is the uncle of O.

2) B is the mother-in-law of H, and H is the mother of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/218ad2ec80da3104c19244caca1582fe00ea9e7c5739dc1c22b8b9461f8123b3.png] 

3) O is granddaughter of S who have only one daughter.

4) W is son-in-law of S and X is the uncle of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adb2cd07cacfd8b8dc110e3b0e0b4429e25b5ec8af3c90e002052532416e8c5f.png] 

Hence,** X is brother-in-law of H.**
